notes: Intro call 2025-11-15 - AE (Ava) + SE (Marcus) + Head of Product (Lina Torres). High-level need: add multi-turn chat assistant for CS tier2 and fast document search for onboarding docs.
Early interest: start on Redwood Hosted API for fast integration; strong preference to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation if SLA and unit economics work out.
Demo 2025-12-02 - hosted API chat demo with 8k-context model. Feedback: latency fine for pilot, token spend is primary concern. Lina: 'We need to hit production cost targets or we'll self-host.'
POC plan agreed 2025-12-10: Phase 1 (hosted API integration + traffic shadowing), Phase 2 (cost workshop & quantization tests), Phase 3 (Dedicated canary using reserved pool for three weeks).

Cost optimization workshop 2026-02-10 - attendees: AE, SE, Product, Infra. Agenda: batching strategy, prefix/KV caching, quantization profiles (4-bit, 8-bit), model routing and fallbacks, unit economics modeling.

Workshop outcomes: technical consensus that ~3x batching + KV prefix caching reduces token cost by ~28% on average for helpdesk flows; 4-bit quantization meets quality bar on short prompts but showed regressions on multi-turn follow-ups - recommended hybrid: 8-bit for chat, 4-bit for embeddings/reranking.

Benchmarks captured during workshop: target p95 latency <= 250ms for chat with 500 concurrent sessions; observed hosted API p95 ~220ms at 200 concurrent; Dedicated projection with batching expected to reduce cost by 35%-50% depending on token profile.

Unit economics note: current vendor baseline (customer reported) ~ $0.095 / 1k tokens. Target after batching+quantization & Dedicated reserved pricing: <$0.04 / 1k tokens at projected 200M monthly tokens. SE built a model (see pricing deck) with sensitivity ranges.

Security: Must have SSO/SAML integration (enterprise SAML flow), KMS for key management, and audit logs retained 1 year. EU residency required for select customers - legal needs exact phrasing for contract.
Procurement timeline: Lina expects procurement + legal sign-off in 6-8 weeks once Dedicated SOW and data residency clause agreed. Budget holder: CTO (Rahul Mehta).
Quote ask: example Dedicated commitment tiers with projected unit costs at 100M/200M/500M tokens per month. Asked for an appendix showing how batching and cache settings map to per-token price.
Open technical items: 1) run quantization quality sweep on 200 long-tail prompts (SE action), 2) SAML test metadata exchange (Infra action), 3) Dedicated network egress plan (Ops action).
Customer sentiment: cautiously optimistic. Quote from Lina in workshop: 'If you can show predictable cost under expected load and sign a residency clause, we move quickly.'
Next meetings: Dedicated POC scoping call scheduled 2026-02-25; procurement intro call tentatively 2026-03-10.
